candidateConcepts.rationale: Umbrella concept connecting safe drivers, roadworthy vehicles, monitoring, and management controls.
Systematic inspection, repair, and maintenance keeps vehicles and safety-critical parts in safe condition.
Inspection identifies unsafe vehicle conditions before they contribute to roadway incidents or breakdowns.
Telematics combines near-real-time vehicle data, diagnostics, utilization, and safety information for fleet decisions.
GPS location, route history, and geofencing are specific fleet-monitoring functions within modern telematics.
Hard braking, rapid acceleration, speeding, seatbelt, and related data can support coaching and risk reduction.
Fatigue can impair alertness, reaction time, judgment, and driving performance.
Attention diversion such as texting increases driving risk and is a core driver-safety issue.
Alcohol, drugs, and some medicines can impair judgment, coordination, reaction time, and safe vehicle operation.

candidateConcepts.canonicalLabel: Electric and Hybrid Vehicle Emergency Safety
candidateConcepts.rationale: Electric-powered vehicles introduce vehicle-specific emergency, towing, storage, submersion, fire, and high-voltage considerations.
